attendance.title: Live attendance
attendance.adminIntro: See each employee’s live location on the map. When someone turns tracking off, you are notified and off-time is recorded below.
attendance.gateMessage: Your live location will be tracked continuously while you use this app. You must allow precise (exact) location access to view tasks and other features.
attendance.gateHint: When your browser asks, choose Precise / exact location only — Approximate is not accepted. You can turn tracking off later in Settings, but your admin will be notified.
attendance.gateDisabledMessage: Turn live location tracking back on to access your tasks. Your admin was notified when you turned it off.
attendance.gateDisabledHint: Open Settings to turn tracking on, or use the button below.
attendance.waitingForLocation: Allow location access using the prompt above to view your tasks.
attendance.permissionDenied: Location permission denied. Allow precise location in your browser to continue.
attendance.preciseLocationRequired: Precise (exact) location is required. When Chrome asks, select Precise — not Approximate — then try again.
attendance.notSupported: This browser does not support location services.
attendance.settingsHint: When off, your admin is notified and you cannot access tasks until tracking is on again.
attendance.disableConfirmMessage: Your admin will be notified immediately. You will lose access to tasks until you turn tracking on again.
attendance.selectEmployee: Select an employee to view off-period history.
attendance.adminNotifyOn: {{name}} turned live location tracking back on.
